usage: deskops issue close [-h] --reason REASON [--ref REF [REF ...]]
                           [--root ROOT] [--force]
                           selector

positional arguments:
  selector             Issue selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --reason REASON      Why the issue is closing.
  --ref REF [REF ...]  Commit or path supporting the close; repeat or space-separate as needed.
  --root ROOT          Target repository root.
  --force              Close again even when already closed.

Example:
  deskops issue close issue-empty-selector --root . --reason "Fixed by the CLI" --ref abc1234 --ref deskops/cli

Selector: issue id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment under desk/issues/ or desk/drawer/issues/.
The issue status is set to closed and a ## Resolution section records Closed, Reason and Refs.
